limitations: Published descriptive regional catalogs: H3K27me3 broad and H3K4me3 narrow; two deposited IP libraries per sex/stage/mark, with matched Input IDs. This compact publication is not certification of complete upstream QC or a combined terminal run. DB remains HOLD: adult sex/instrument confounding and unresolved source-pool relationships. H3K27me3 strict direct comparison failed for one nearest-gene assignment in each male group (shared TSS, Smp_095580/Smp_341610); original assignments retained and ambiguity not assessed. H3K4me3 preserves assessed and unassessed ambiguity, and IDR <=0.05 is separate evidence, not the annotation catalog. No regulation or occupancy significance is inferred. BAMs, individual peak coordinates and bigWig signals are not published in this compact package. Adult/cercaria RNA from this accession remain excluded; use compatible approved RNA studies without sample pairing.

db_review.pairing_rationale: Male and female parasite pools are distinct samples. Neither matching replicate numbers nor the shared generic BioSample establishes matched biological units across sex.
db_review.biological_unit_definition: Independently collected parasite pool and chromatin preparation, not an individual sequenced read, sequencing run or Input library.
db_review.biological_independence_status: The publications describe biological replication, including two male replicates, but an exact source-pool mapping for the two selected female libraries per stage has not been established. A shared BioSample is not evidence of either independence or pseudoreplication.

h3k27me3_qc.interpretation: Marked between-library variation requires review before inferential DB; no universal broad-mark FRiP pass threshold was imposed. Minimum-one regional inclusion is not replication certification.

db_review.confounding_and_scope_of_inference: The adult male-versus-female effect cannot be separated from sequencing instrument in the selected libraries. A group-only model would estimate a combined difference, not an isolated sex effect. Do not label deposited Adult libraries as paired or sexually mature paired worms; the publications describe unisexual infections and distinguish somatic differentiation from sexual maturity.
db_review.normalization_review: PENDING_IF_DB_BECOMES_ELIGIBLE; no claim of absolute occupancy, spike-in calibration or validated invariant regions.
